#!/bin/bash -x

# If a bundle file is present, call tox with the jenkins version of
# the test environment so it is used.  Otherwise, use the normal
# (non-bundle) test environment.  Also, run pbr freeze on the
# resulting environment at the end so that we have a record of exactly
# what packages we ended up testing.
#
# Usage: run-tox.sh VENV
#
# Where VENV is the name of the tox environment to run (specified in the
# project's tox.ini file).

venv=$1
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

if [[ -z "$venv" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $?"
    echo
    echo "VENV: The tox environment to run (eg 'python27')"
    exit 1
fi

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}

function freeze_venv {
    [ -e $bin_path/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

    echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
    echo "======================================================================"
    ${bin_path}/${freezecmd} freeze | sort -f
    echo "======================================================================"
}

function process_testr_artifacts {
    if [ ! -d ".testrepository" ] ; then
        return
    fi

    if [ -f ".testrepository/0.2" ] ; then
        cp .testrepository/0.2 ./testrepository.subunit
    elif [ -f ".testrepository/0" ] ; then
        $bin_path/testr last --subunit > ./testrepository.subunit
    fi
    #/usr/bin/subunit2html ./testrepository.subunit testr_results.html
    $bin_path/subunit2html ./testrepository.subunit testr_results.html
    SUBUNIT_SIZE=$(du -k ./testrepository.subunit | awk '{print $1}')
    gzip -9 ./testrepository.subunit
    gzip -9 ./testr_results.html

    if [[ "$SUBUNIT_SIZE" -gt 50000 ]]; then
        echo
        echo "testrepository.subunit was > 50 MB of uncompressed data!!!"
        echo "Something is causing tests for this project to log significant amounts"
        echo "of data. This may be writers to python logging, stdout, or stderr."
        echo "Failing this test as a result"
        echo
        exit 1
    fi

    rancount=$($bin_path/testr last | sed -ne 's/Ran \([0-9]\+\).*tests in.*//p')
    if [ -z "$rancount" ] || [ "$rancount" -eq "0" ] ; then
        echo
        echo "Zero tests were run. At least one test should have been run."
        echo "Failing this test as a result"
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_sudo_usage {
    sudo $script_path/jenkins-sudo-grep.sh post
    sudoresult=$?

    if [ $sudoresult -ne "0" ]; then
        echo
        echo "This test has failed because it attempted to execute commands"
        echo "with sudo.  See above for the exact commands used."
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_oom {
    $script_path/jenkins-oom-grep.sh post
    oomresult=$?

    if [ $oomresult -ne "0" ]; then
        echo
        echo "This test has failed because it attempted to exceed configured"
        echo "memory limits and was killed prior to completion.  See above"
        echo "for related kernel messages."
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_nose_html {
    htmlreport=$(find . -name $NOSE_HTML_OUT_FILE)
    if [ -f "$htmlreport" ]; then
        passcount=$(grep -c 'tr class=.passClass' $htmlreport)
        if [ $passcount -eq "0" ]; then
            echo
            echo "Zero tests passed, which probably means there was an error"
            echo "parsing one of the python files, or that some other failure"
            echo "during test setup prevented a sane run."
            echo
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
}


script_path=/usr/local/jenkins/slave_scripts
bin_path=.tox/$venv/bin

export PYTHON=$bin_path/python
export NOSE_WITH_XUNIT=1
export NOSE_WITH_HTML_OUTPUT=1
export NOSE_HTML_OUT_FILE='nose_results.html'
if [[ -z "$TMPDIR" ]]; then
    export TMPDIR=$(/bin/mktemp -d)
fi
trap "rm -rf $TMPDIR" EXIT

export_upper_constratints_file

#cat /etc/image-hostname.txt

#$script_path/jenkins-oom-grep.sh pre

#sudo $script_path/jenkins-sudo-grep.sh pre

tox -v -e$venv
result=$?

freeze_venv
process_testr_artifacts
#check_sudo_usage
#check_oom
check_nose_html

# Rename tox' .log files to .log.txt so that Apache serves them as
# text/plain files since it can handle .txt special - and .log is
# unknown and therefore served as binary.
find .tox -type f -name "*.log" -exec mv {} {}.txt \;

exit $result

#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=`dirname $0`
SERVICE=nmtool_cm_agent

export startType=0
startType=$(cat $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini | grep startType | awk -F '=' '{print $2}')
if [[ $startType -eq "1" ]]
then
	systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -eq 0 ]
		then
        sudo systemctl stop nmtool_cm_agent
	else
	   echo "${SERVICE} is not running"
	fi
else 
	systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
	if [ $? -eq 0 ]
	then
		systemctl stop nmtool_cm_agent.service
	fi

	pids=`ps -ef |grep manager.py |grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}'`
	if [ "$pids" != "" ]; then

		#kill -9 $pids
		echo pids=$pids
		kill -9 $pids
		echo "stop nmtool_cm_agent process successfully"
	else
		pids=`netstat -tunlp | grep 10081 | grep -v grep | awk '{print $7}'`
		kill -9 ${pids%%/*}
	fi
fi

@echo off
setlocal ENABLEDELAYEDEXPANSION
:: param1---node.zip
set node_file_pre=%1
:: ---------------------------prepare node path--------------------------------------
set node_parent=D:
op\necho node_parent=%node_parent%
set node_path=%node_parent%%node_file_pre%\necho "node_path:"%node_path%
set path=%node_path%;C:\Program Files\WinRAR;%path%
echo "path:"%path%
set origin_folder=%~dp0
echo %origin_folder%
cd ..
set parent_folder=%cd%
echo parent_folder%parent_folder%
set tool_folder=%parent_folder%\dev_tools
echo tool_folder%tool_folder%
if not exist %node_path% (
	echo remove dir %node_path%
	rd /s /q %node_path%
	call WinRAR.exe X %tool_folder%\%node_file_pre%.zip %node_parent%
)

cd %origin_folder%

::---------------------------check ng-----------------------------------
:ng
call where ng
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		:ngOK
		echo "-----ng is already installed-----"
		call ng version
	) else (
		:: config npm registry
		echo "-----set npm registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm -----"
		call npm config set registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm

		cd %node_path%

	::---------------------------install ng-----------------------------------
		echo "-----install @angular/cli@8.1.0... -----"
		call npm install @angular/cli@8.1.0
		if !errorlevel!==0 (
			call ng version
		) else (
			@echo "-----global install ng cli failed! -----"
			goto end
		)
	)
::--- add --max_old_space_size=4096 to ng.cmd
call xcopy %tool_folder%
g.cmd %node_path% /H /K /R /Y

::---------------------------check waf-----------------------------------
:waf
call where waf
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		:wafOK
		echo "-----waf is already installed-----"
		call waf --version
	) else (
	::---------------------------install waf-----------------------------------
		:: set node-sass binary path just for this bat
		echo parent_folder=%parent_folder%
		set SASS_BINARY_PATH=%tool_folder%\win32-x64-64_binding.node
		echo "SASS_BINARY_PATH:" !SASS_BINARY_PATH!
		:: config npm registry
		echo "-----set npm registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm -----"
		call npm config set registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm

		cd %node_path%

		echo "-----install waf... -----"
		call npm install @waf_cli/cli

		if !errorlevel!==0 (
			call waf --version
		) else (
			echo "-----install waf cli failed! -----"
			goto end
		)
	)

:: ---------------------------check npm 3.10.10--------------------------------------
for /F %%i in ('npm -v')do set npm_version=%%i
echo npm_version=!npm_version!
if !npm_version!==3.10.10 (
	call npm -v
) else (
    echo "-----npm version is not avalable!-----"
	echo "-----replace npm@!npm_version! with npm@3.10.10 -----"
	if exist %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip del %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip
	xcopy %tool_folder%
pm@3.10.10.zip	 %node_path%
ode_modules\n	rd %node_path%
ode_modules
pm /S /Q
	call WinRAR.exe X %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip %node_path%
ode_modules
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		echo "-----npm@3.10.10 is already installed! current version:-----"
		call npm -v
	) else (
		echo "-----install npm@3.10.10 failed! -----"
		goto end
	)
)

cd %origin_folder%
call build-2.bat %node_file_pre%
:end
echo "-----end pre-build.bat-----"
